analysis.pricePattern: Higher Low 지속 및 5일 신고가 경신
analysis.pricePatternEn: Higher Low continuation and 5-day new high

analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 68.7 entering overbought territory, MACD histogram improving to 4.0358. 5-day high of $263.19 breached, nearing 52-week high. ADX at 23.2 indicates early trend formation, but weekly RSI at 72.2 and weekly ADX at 43.5 confirm strong long-term uptrend. 4-hour RSI at 72.7 aligns with daily. This suggests continued upward momentum.
